d: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang is back in the spotlight following reports about his alleged extramarital affairs. According to a Wall Street Journal report, Huang reportedly acknowledged having more than three affairs during a meeting with the company's board. Earlier reports by The New York Times and Reuters had linked him to multiple women, including NVIDIA employees. The company's board reportedly approved his return as President and CEO after discussions involving national security concerns. The controversy has brought renewed attention to Huang's personal life, leadership and NVIDIA's future.
